Successive Poisson reset cycles give independent time-displacement pairs with finite moments; the centered renewal-reward CLT yields the long-time covariance. Exact n=1,2 angle transforms produce the rational formulas, and differentiating the gap yields a positive factor times (2 alpha-r). Symbolic identities and independent numerical cycle-moment evaluations replay successfully; there are no finite-enumeration claims.

value.rationale: The primary sorting model explicitly motivates diffusion control and non-periodic orientation resets. The new complete invariant identifies fluctuation principal axes, covariance growth and a sharp universal interior optimal rate for isotropic translational mobility with nonzero angular cross-coupling. It is not a generic theorem restatement, known-table value or arbitrary parameter choice: the objective is the natural principal-diffusivity gap and the optimizer applies for all allowed positive mobilities.
